rules.description: Always keep version numbers synchronized across the project.
rules.action: When making any code changes or bug fixes, always ensure that the version number is updated (minor for features, patch for bug fixes) in the following files:

rules.description: Always document changes in the public README.
rules.action: Any changes, features, or bug fixes must be thoroughly documented in the 'Recent Patches' section of the README.md file. Ensure that new patches are grouped under a specific heading for the exact version being worked on (e.g. '### v1.0.1').
At the start of a session or when exploring the codebase, read 'AI_NOTES.md' to quickly reorient yourself on the architecture, bookmarks, hooks, and bugfix flows.

rules.description: Always repackage the mod after making changes.
rules.action: After compiling, always run the packaging script to produce the Thunderstore release zip file.
